name: smwpatches-yoshi-color-depending-on-initial-x-position
title: Yoshi Color Depending on Initial X Position
description:
This patch will make Yoshi and Baby Yoshi act similarly to the Yoshi Egg sprite, where placing it at different X positions changes its color. This will affect:
- Baby Yoshi.
- Yoshi placed directly in the level.
- Yoshi Egg spawned from ?-blocks (which in turn affects the Yoshi hatched from the egg).
In the asm file you can customize which color is set for which position.
